prompt: Vertical 9:16 view of the old village pub from the street, the same kind of building as in the photo: a two-storey honey-coloured stone house with a grey stone-slate roof, two brick chimneys, the front wall thick with ivy, dark-framed small-paned windows and a low doorway with a small canopy and two brass lanterns either side. It is dusk: the sky deep blue fading to a last band of pale orange, the street empty and slightly damp. Every downstairs window glows warm amber from lamps inside, with soft shapes of people behind the glass; the lanterns by the door are lit. A plain painted hanging sign board with only a simple picture on it. Pavement and road in the foreground. All signs and boards plain and unmarked. Quiet, real, a little moody, like a real photo taken on a phone at dusk.
